label: Universal-source preexistence from universal transfer and universal-source possession
meaning: Let c be a universal cause of being, x another thing whose being c causes, and r a perfection x has. Universal-scope transfer b26c10a0 gives that c causes x's being r; universal-source possession gives that c has r. It is the universal-scope counterpart of e8a3eb51 (preexistence from unrestricted transfer f8ba2429 and cause-of-being possession d0fc96b7): no nonuniversal transfer 10cd24ed is used. Conditional consequence only; both premises stay open.
